value.signature: fn fmt (& self , f : & mut fmt :: Formatter < '_ >) -> fmt :: Result

exception.justification: Justified: Formatting supplies the public representation to the enclosing observation boundary and must not recursively create another observation.

review.body: { write ! (f , "line {}, column {}: {}" , self . line , self . column , self . detail) }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-interchange decision for cddl::lex::<SyntaxError as fmt :: Display>::fmt.
